title: Observation record
description: A single sourced observation collected during the Observe phase. Observations are the only permitted raw material for candidate ideas.

lens.description: The isolated research lens that produced this observation. See references/search-lenses.md.

claim.description: One factual sentence stating what was observed. No product ideas, no solutions.

detail.description: Longer context: who, what, when, how often, at what cost.

quote.description: Short verbatim excerpt (under 15 words) or paraphrase supporting the claim.

sources.description: For lens=private-edge, use type=private and put an opaque label in url (e.g. private://notes/2025-q3), never the private content itself.

observed_actor.description: Who exhibits the behavior (narrow: 'freelance tax accountants in DE', not 'businesses').

facets.description: Facet decomposition used by the Diverge phase. Fill what the evidence supports; omit what it does not. See references/facets.md.

confidence.description: reported = one source says so; corroborated = 2+ independent sources; verified = directly checked (ran the code, read the regulation, saw the pricing page).
